DesignLineage: The DeFever 41 was built in Taiwan from 1980–1995, first by Miracle Marine and later by Bluewater Marine.
Arthur DeFever regarded the 38/40/41 size family as closely related in concept, but the fiberglass 41 has its own documented production identity.
At least two interior arrangements were offered, both with two private staterooms and galley aft in the salon.
Single 210-hp Cummins and twin 135-hp Lehman installations are both documented, so engine count is intentionally not fixed in B-Atlas.
OwnershipCharacter: Excellent liveaboard value and very economical in single-engine form, with secure decks and useful storage. Exterior teak, old tanks, windows and decades of electrical/plumbing modifications can create substantial refit work; twin-engine examples add machinery complexity.
